item.title: Vatican: Pope Leo to leave hospital Saturday
item.description: The Vatican said Pope Leo XIV will be discharged on Saturday, four days after surgery.

item.title: Rhode Island farmer sets world record for largest pumpkin
item.description: David Muir reports on a new world record for heaviest pumpkin at 3,156 pounds, surpassing the previous 2,856-pound record.
